name: LivePlan
summary: LivePlan builds profit, balance sheet and cash flow forecasts for a single small business, with up to 10 forecast scenarios and budget versus actual dashboards. Plans cost $15 to $30 a month on annual billing and include five contributors, so it suits an owner or a small finance team rather than a multi-entity group.

facts.text: Both plans include one active company at a time and five contributors, with unlimited guests.
Up to 10 full forecast scenarios and CSV export of forecasts to Excel or Google Sheets are listed on the pricing page.
All subscriptions come with a 35-day money-back guarantee, and the page says there are no contracts.
LivePlan's page lists QuickBooks Online and Xero connections as Premium features.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: $20 a month when not billed annually. The page does not name the currency; it shows a dollar sign. 1 active company and 5 contributors

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: $40 a month when not billed annually. Adds deeper research, scenarios and financial analysis per the page tagline

plans.name: LivePlan Expert (add-on)
plans.notes: 30-minute one-on-one video meetings; not a standalone plan

hiddenCosts: Only one company can be active at a time, so a bookkeeper or advisor with several clients has to switch between them.

contract.cancellation: The page says there are no contracts and offers a 35-day money-back guarantee. It does not say how to cancel or whether plans renew automatically.
contract.dataExport: Forecasts export as CSV for Excel or Google Sheets.
